object.attr: derived: `.git/config` and `.github` files are inside the repository but no tool's business, and an ID, a name or `commit_changes`' `paths` can reach them (CF-M57). Whether `commit_changes` may name a file outside the document folders is VER's to decide.
object.description: The MCP server shall accept a path to a file outside the document folders only in `set_figure`'s `source_path` and `export_document`'s `out_path`.
